from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def base(p,t,x,v):
    return p[0]*v**2 + p[1]*np.sin(p[2]*np.sqrt(v)) + p[3]*np.exp(-p[4]*t**2)*v
def full(p,t,x,v):
    return base(p,t,x,v) + p[5]*x**p[6]*t/(1+p[7]*x)**p[8]
best=None
for s in range(40):
    p0=np.random.RandomState(s).uniform(0.2,2,9)
    try:
        r=least_squares(lambda q: full(q,t,x,v)-dv_dt, p0)
        if np.isfinite(r.cost) and (best is None or r.cost<best.cost): best=r
    except Exception: pass
p=best.x
print("params",np.round(p,4),"nmse",np.mean((full(p,t,x,v)-dv_dt)**2)/np.var(dv_dt))
